d: Russia launched a missile and drone assault on Kyiv as a local ceasefire began in Russian-occupied Oleshky, intended to allow humanitarian aid deliveries and civilian evacuations. Ukrainian authorities reported damage to a university campus, the Southern Bridge, administrative buildings and medical facilities. Russia separately claimed it had struck a Ukrainian drone-production facility. In Oleshky, residents speak of shortages of food, water and medicine are waiting for relief and safe evacuation routes.
